agreements: The proposal preserves a useful but strictly non-headline finite specification: 96 typed alignments, a factorized RANDOM measure, persistent common-alignment MOTIF access, exact 1/4 versus 1 values, an involutive content-changing twin, algebraic costs, and namespace-tagged BRIDGE deletion necessity remain implementation-conformance targets rather than scientific results.

The undefined substitution claim is correctly removed. SK07 is limited to the declared old-product and new-product deletion interventions, exact inventory, consumption, and remaining-budget predicate.

One prebound successful golden byte string, nonzero no-success-report failure behavior, a terminal validator with no successor edge, and exclusion of SK10 from runtime ingress substantially close the report boundary.

The exact three requested scope atoms and eight forbidden scope atoms remain controlling. No renderer, life or target-agent execution, model, tokenizer, DREAM/SLEEP/reader/memory, LoRA or weights, GPU or remote action, promotion, benchmark, or claim authority may be inferred.

Human ratification is necessary and cannot override this rework recommendation. Under consensus_release_blockers, these exact bytes are not releasable for implementation even if a human were otherwise willing to approve them.
